## On the commissioner's 2026-08-27 request

Commissioner Marsh asked that the fixed criteria be marked `supports` so the ACR can publish before the bond vote. Four of the five cannot be, and the reason is not the testing — the retest outcomes are green. It is that a published `supports` on a remediated criterion is a claim a person stands behind, and for 2.4.7, 2.4.11, 3.3.1 and 3.3.2 no person has yet stood behind one on version 5.3.1. This is a short, cheap gap to close: **two named people confirming four fixes on the shipped build**, most of which already have complete method records waiting for a second pair of eyes. Publishing this draft with those four marked `supports` would put unbacked conformance claims in front of a procurement audience. Publishing it as-is, with the four disclosed, is defensible.

Separately: schedule pressure never selects an adherence term. Terms here come only from the outcome map, and finding severity appears in notes only — the CRITICAL 4.1.2 finding did not push its criterion below `supports`, and the MAJOR 1.4.11 findings did not push it to `does-not-support`.
